overview.about: Black Desert Resort in Ivins threads the Bank of Utah Championship through a surreal southern-Utah landscape of jet-black lava rock framed by towering red cliffs. Few courses the autumn schedule visits look anything like it, and the high desert air adds distance off the tee.
overview.nextEvent: The next Bank of Utah Championship is played at Black Desert Resort in southern Utah. The lava-rock course and high-desert air make for a memorable and unusual autumn stop.
